pages.title: Causal Solder
pages.text: Solder that joins things across time. Tachyon crystal lets it flow backwards, chronon capacitors keep the loop stable, and components soldered with it are connected before they are made. It feels slightly older than it is.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Closed timelike curves let something be sent back before it was made. Running exotic solder through the Chronon Field Inverter with a Tachyon Crystal, I got solder that joined things across time.
